scope: Independent source review of guarded local unpacked development-build support for Debug export QA.

verdict_a_runtime.evidence: No browser or test was launched by this review lane. The prepared command states that it targets the existing local 0.2.85 keyed build and explicitly disclaims any native result or published-release claim.
missing: Actual unpacked dev extension launch and acceptance results for T16/T18 remain unverified; the root-owned resource-guarded run is still required.

evidence: Without DEBUG_DEV_BUILD_RECEIPT, the runner calls the same harness entry with no override, preserving its release-receipt path; the harness verifies release tree and store ZIP before launch.

With the opt-in set, the runner validates local_dev_unpacked/not_published receipt fields, fixed .output/chrome-mv3-dev identity, nonempty manifest key, package/manifest/receipt version equality, and a pre-run tree hash. The harness rereads and validates the receipt, checks expected identity, and verifies the tree again before launching the verified unpacked path.

After the run, the runner re-reads identity and hashes the extension tree again before recording completion. Existing T16/T18 oracles and privacy safeguards are unchanged; the report stores bounded metadata and does not store clipboard, event, or download text.
Resource policy is unchanged and already contains the exact node runner argv. No acceptance threshold, private output handling, or published-release claim was weakened.
verdict_b_source_quality.recommendation: Proceed with the separate root-owned, resource-guarded native run. Keep its result labeled as local development-build QA, and do not call runtime acceptance complete until the receipt and resulting run evidence are inspected.

review_limits: This is source review only; the local receipt is an integrity snapshot for accidental build drift, not a cryptographic attestation against a local actor who can rewrite both files.
No heavy checks, browser, or application UI were run, per lane boundary.
